independentDiscovery.method: A separate read-only reviewer inspected upstream source, manifest, documentation and tests before reading the first inventory.
addedFamilies: Project discovery, ownership, includes and solver options
Parse, resolution and verification diagnostic distinctions
Cache migration, fairness and resource contention
Plugin handlers, startup failures and assertion splitting
independentDiscovery.limitation: Source discovery does not establish local runtime support. No additional runtime passes were awarded by the audit.

latestAudit.method: Read-only skeptic rediscovered features before reading the inventory; separate source scanner enumerated test files and registration sites before inventory reconciliation.

finderReview.finding: Successful exit could reuse stale host evidence
finderReview.resolution: Per-launch identity and structured result validation
finderReview.regression: offline parity launcher rejects stale success

finderReview.finding: Detached verifier could survive normal editor exit
finderReview.resolution: Terminate sampled owned survivors with PID/start-time identity checks before starting another trial
finderReview.regression: a normal editor exit cannot leave a sampled detached verifier in the next trial

finderReview.finding: Scenario timeouts were hidden by aggregate broken status
finderReview.resolution: Preserve timeout status and timeout rate
finderReview.regression: a scenario timeout survives a successful editor exit in machine summaries

finderReview.finding: Missing and empty observations counted as passes
finderReview.resolution: Separate partial, missing and unexamined outcomes; require actual counterexample evidence

finderReview.finding: Final renderer capture could outlive a trial
finderReview.resolution: Track and await the capture task; label screenshots as end-of-run observations

finderReview.finding: Instrumentation changed execFile custom promisify behavior
finderReview.resolution: Preserve original identities except the observed spawn function
finderReview.regression: child-process observation preserves custom promisify semantics and excludes unrelated extensions

finderReview.finding: Long artifact paths could exceed the Unix socket-path limit
finderReview.resolution: Store editor state under a short temporary root and retain failed attempts
finderReview.regression: long artifact paths do not become long editor IPC/profile paths

extensionFix.finding: An edit or newer request during an asynchronous save could let an obsolete request start verification
extensionFix.resolution: Track pending-save request identities, invalidate them on edits/closure/cancellation/new requests, bound save retries, and require a clean buffer
extensionFix.preservedInvariant: Exact backend/editor source-hash equality remains mandatory
extensionFix.remainingBoundary: VS Code 1.108 can report a newer buffer clean after writing older bytes. The live scenario records both hashes and uses explicit editor Save for recovery; automatic persistence recovery remains partial.

concurrencyAddendum.finding: Each ExecutionEngine creates its own checker pool and VcsCores semaphore. Dafny ProjectManager.GetBoogie owns an engine per project, so whole-server multi-project activity is not a global worker-count cap.
concurrencyAddendum.runtimeScope: CPU-active process counts cover the entire suite, including concurrent projects, cancellation and restart; they do not establish exact simultaneous instructions.

findingsAndRepairs.finding: Failed launch metrics affected medians and parallel scaling
findingsAndRepairs.repair: Exclude failed timing samples, retain failures and timeout rates
findingsAndRepairs.regression: failed launches cannot improve latency or manufacture parallel scaling

findingsAndRepairs.finding: Non-initial scenarios accepted terminal failures as proofs
findingsAndRepairs.repair: Check expected statuses and exact local function identity set in every proof scenario
findingsAndRepairs.regression: every verification scenario must check expected proof outcomes, not just terminal counts

findingsAndRepairs.finding: Fresh inconsistent scenario/check/aggregate reports could pass
findingsAndRepairs.repair: Validate identities, unique IDs, passed checks and aggregate status
findingsAndRepairs.regression: fresh report identity cannot conceal inconsistent or invented scenario passes

findingsAndRepairs.finding: Empty and truncated protocol recordings appeared observed
findingsAndRepairs.repair: Finalize framing; distinguish empty, partial and corrupt recordings; stop recording at finalization
findingsAndRepairs.regression: empty, unfinalized and corrupt recordings cannot certify an observed protocol

findingsAndRepairs.finding: Source inventory mapped untested APIs to unrelated scenario passes
findingsAndRepairs.repair: Map providers to targeted editor/stdio scenarios; leave code-action evidence unexamined

findingsAndRepairs.finding: Dafny service edits could overlap measured proof work
findingsAndRepairs.repair: Run editor service edits after proof metrics; stdio uses Never and explicit native symbol scheduling

findingsAndRepairs.finding: Stdio shutdown and nonzero exits did not affect success
findingsAndRepairs.repair: Require shutdown acknowledgement, graceful exit zero, bounded version probe and owned-process cleanup
regressions: stdio provider successes cannot hide nonzero-exit
stdio provider successes cannot hide ignored-shutdown

findingsAndRepairs.finding: Stdio memory reserve incompatible with ordinary CI hosts
findingsAndRepairs.repair: Recorded configurable memory reserve/cap; CI explicitly chooses 2048 MiB reserve

findingsAndRepairs.finding: Shape-only hover and navigation assertions could accept unrelated values
findingsAndRepairs.repair: Require meaningful hover text and exact declaration/reference/rename ranges and replacement text
findingsAndRepairs.regression: service observations reject empty hover, wrong navigation and arbitrary rename edits

harnessIntegrityReview.remainingScope: Changed editor-host scenarios are reviewed but not executed here; stdio does not establish UI behavior or full parity.

finalReadOnlyReview.finder: No remaining material issues after fixes; lifecycle, limits, bounded probes and exact provider assertions verified by inspection.
finalReadOnlyReview.skeptic: Fresh results and explicit unexamined scope match evidence; corrected default direct-vs-certified architecture paragraph.

unresolvedPerformanceInvestigation.result: Local eight-hover batch slower than Dafny across repeated trials; synchronous generation fingerprint scans measured separately as a plausible contributor.
unresolvedPerformanceInvestigation.status: partial: cause investigated; production freshness validation not altered
